## Who is Julien Bonnel?
Innovation, AI and Digital Sovereignty expert with 30+ years in the software industry.
Currently: Head of Innovation Funding & Grants at ChapsVision (French Tech Next40).
Also: President & co-founder of Blockchain Innov, Lecturer at Université Côte d'Azur.

## Key Expertise
Innovation management, AI strategy, Digital Sovereignty (SecNumCloud), Software design,
Collaborative projects, Blockchain & Web3, Digital Marketing, Innovation Funding (BPI, ANR, etc.)
